purpose: Acquire fresh, official, offer-card-scoped evidence for held Batch 19 candidates without authorizing publication.
requirements: Acquire only official first-party pages or official API responses. Record requested/final URL, HTTP status, capture timestamp, raw bytes and SHA-256; no inferred or third-party claims.
Prioritize source pages that expose an isolated explicit offer card, card ID and offer-specific title, price, conditions, Da Nang/locality applicability and 2026 validity or recurrence.
Do not alter prior R3 vault files or registry. Store every new source in a new R4 vault with immutable raw HTML/JSON, metadata and SHA-256 sidecars.

For any candidate proposed for future verification, create a manifest record binding leaf ID, raw SHA, metadata SHA, explicit DOM/API selector, card byte/range or JSON pointer, card ID and each evidence span.

Run R3-R9 evaluator only against an anchored registry extension created from the new sealed R4 vault. An extension must be separately hashed and replayable; registry update is evidence-only and cannot authorize staging hydration.
Return a candid shortfall report. Candidates lacking a directed locality or current validity claim must remain HELD; do not manufacture nationwide/Da Nang applicability.
No staging hydration, candidate packaging, production deployment, scheduler/alias mutation or rollback. CEO review is required before any future VERIFIED output can be consumed.
acceptance_gate: CEO source-quality and replay review required; no automatic promotion or deployment
